purpose: Teach: アワ/ニャン/童貞/メヒコ/ペセタ/ルーシー/レヴィナス/スラブ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お土産で四国徳島のアワ、つまり粟雑炊を持って来て下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer brought you an awameshi from Tokushima in Shikoku as a souvenir.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle delivery. Lingering slightly on the detail—marveling quietly at this small kindness. A note of affection for how Aoi connects with people.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペットの猫が「ニャン」と鳴くお話で笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer was laughing while telling me about their cat meowing.
lines.style: Slight smile in the voice. Wry but genuine—there's real delight in the absurdity of it. Quick, light rhythm. The tone says: isn't that a funny thing to connect over?

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、若い頃の童貞文学のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They shared some stories about literature from when they were younger.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the opening. Soft, unhurried. Respectful of the vulnerability in someone offering their past. Slight trailing-off—letting the moment settle.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スペイン語でメキシコ、つまりメヒコと呼ぶって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned how Mexico is called Méjico in Spanish.
lines.style: Curious, conversational rhythm. Light emphasis on the word shift—noticing a detail that delights them. Warm, like sharing something learned with someone you like.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、旧スペインの通貨ペセタのお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They told me about the peseta, Spain's old currency.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wondering tone. The kind of voice you use when someone shares something obscure they care about. Even-paced, attentive. Honoring how much this person knows.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「ピーナッツ」の犬ルーシーが好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned they love Lucy, the dog from Peanuts.
lines.style: A small smile—recognizing something universal and sweet. Lightweight delivery. Brief, appreciative. The tone of noticing when someone's love of something simple is also a kind of honesty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、哲学者レヴィナスの倫理学に詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They're knowledgeable about the ethics of the philosopher Levinas.
lines.style: Respectful, almost reverent tone. Measured pace. Not performed—genuine admiration in the voice for someone's intellect. Slight pause, letting the depth of it land.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヨーロッパのスラブ系言語に詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They know a lot about the Slavic languages of Europe.
lines.style: Closing warmth. Soft, admiring. A gentle wrap-up to the portrait they've been building together. The tone settles—Mei and Aoi seeing this person clearly, completely, with affection.
